appearances.snippet: Becca (viewer; surname unverified) writes, Erika (Erika Kirk) at age 25 while living in Michigan had a very inappropriate relationship with a 15-year-old child and is sick. What Erika (Erika Kirk) messaged to this girl, she groomed her for almost a year.

verification.notes: Transcript context shows this was a viewer accusation read aloud, not Candace Owens's own verified finding. Searches found circulating screenshots and commentary, but reputable current coverage says the screenshots remain unauthenticated, the woman has not made a public grooming complaint, and there is no official investigation. Lack of proof is not proof of falsity, so the allegation remains unverifiable.

verification.notes: Public material supports a 2013 Michigan connection and Erika Frantzve's birth date, but not the full compound claim.
